All — I reviewed the security questionnaire and attached our current responses (security-questionnaire-responses.pdf). Key callouts:

- SOC2 Type II: we can share the latest report under NDA; recommend we provide the summary and the auditor contact.
- KMS/HSM: MedSecure asked about an on-prem key management option. For hosted Redwood we do not support customer-hosted on-prem KMS for the pilot. We can offer cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and provide an attestation on encryption-in-transit and at-rest. Suggest the following language for the security exception: "Customer requests on-prem KMS for pilot; Redwood will provide cloud-KMS attestation and an encryption key-handling overview. A permanent on-prem KMS solution is out of scope for the pilot and would require a dedicated private deployment agreement."
- Data retention & logs: recommend we include a 90-day logs retention for the pilot and provide an export on request.

Potential blockers: If Rajiv insists on on-prem KMS or a SOC2 scoped auditor call, that will add 2–3 weeks. Recommend we push the procurement kickoff but be transparent about these items.

I've created a short internal ticket with suggested legal language: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-482

Next steps (actionable)
- Sean: update SOW with the 10% one-time pilot discount, net-45 payment term (subject to finance approval), and the capped SLA language Marissa proposed.
- Neha: I'll prepare the SOC2 summary and KMS attestation and share under NDA by EOD tomorrow.
- Marissa / Jonas: confirm finance/legal approvals so we can get DocuSign ready.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
